lenders.name: National Health Investors (NHI) - mortgage, mezzanine and construction loans
lenders.parent_or_aka: National Health Investors, Inc. (NYSE: NHI), healthcare REIT
lenders.programs: Mezzanine loans to operators, Construction loans (AL), Mortgage notes (acquisition / refinance)
lenders.rate_range: 9.0%-10.0% on disclosed 2025 loans (e.g. 9.0% ALF construction loan; 9.4% Vizion Health mezz; 10.0% CFG mezz)
lenders.term: e.g. construction loan maturing April 2030; mezz extended to May 2028
lenders.broker_program: No broker program published. Loans disclosed in SEC filings go to operator relationships (Encore Senior Living construction loan, Vizion Health mezz) and to Capital Funding Group (mezz facility), often alongside purchase options. Treat as a capital source for established operators, not a broker desk.
lenders.fit_notes: REIT that makes loans to operators: up to $28.0M AL construction loan (MI, May 2025), new $18.8M and $11.3M mortgage notes (late 2025), operator mezz. Useful for Corin operator clients who want REIT growth capital; no documented broker channel or CA loan.

lenders.name: BOK Financial - Senior Housing & Care
lenders.parent_or_aka: BOKF, NA / BOK Financial Corporation (Bank of Oklahoma, Bank of Texas, etc.)
lenders.footprint: National (senior housing team lends outside the bank's branch states)
lenders.programs: Senior housing construction loans, Bridge loans, Acquisition / refinance term loans, Treasury / deposit services
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program. Direct relationship lender to experienced owner-operators; the bank describes starting with lower initial loan amounts plus earn-outs until labor costs and occupancy stabilize.
lenders.contact_title: Senior housing construction financing team (listed on BOK Financial senior housing page)
lenders.fit_notes: Dedicated senior housing and care team. Says it has provided more than $3.7B of construction and bridge financing since 2011 on 21,000+ units, with a named construction-lending team. Good fit for AL/MC construction and bridge deals. CA activity and broker acceptance are not documented.

lenders.name: Texas Capital - Healthcare Banking (healthcare real estate)
lenders.parent_or_aka: Texas Capital Bank / Texas Capital Bancshares (NASDAQ: TCBI)
lenders.footprint: National (healthcare real estate coverage described as across the United States)
lenders.programs: Healthcare real estate loans, Healthcare ABL, Cash-flow loans
lenders.broker_program: No broker program published. Five-person healthcare banking team added mid-2025 (ABL, cash flow and real estate), with a stated new push into healthcare real estate for skilled nursing, assisted living and memory care.
lenders.fit_notes: New 2025 healthcare team covering SNF / AL / MC real estate nationally. Worth a call for operator-quality bank balance-sheet deals; CA activity and broker acceptance are unconfirmed.

lenders.name: Dougherty Mortgage LLC
lenders.footprint: National; deal history concentrated in the Upper Midwest
lenders.property_types: Senior housing (IL/AL/MC), Seniors cooperatives, Age-restricted multifamily
lenders.programs: HUD 232/223(f), HUD 232/223(a)(7), HUD 213 cooperative construction, HUD 221(d)(4), Fannie Mae Seniors Housing (DUS)
lenders.broker_program: No broker program found. Agency lender; deals reported as 'arranged' or 'originated' by Dougherty.
lenders.licenses: FHA MAP and LEAN approved (per trade coverage); Fannie Mae DUS (per trade coverage)
lenders.fit_notes: LEAN-approved HUD 232 plus Fannie seniors lender. Most reported deals are 2017-2020 Midwest, so current activity and CA appetite need a call.

lenders.name: Paragon Mortgage Corporation
lenders.term: e.g. 25-yr fully amortizing (2020 North Hollywood SNF HUD 232/223 refinance)
lenders.fit_notes: Closed a $16.34M HUD 232/223 refinance for a 128-bed SNF in North Hollywood, CA (2020). Last healthcare deal found is from 2020, so confirm the firm is still active in HUD 232 before outreach.

lenders.name: iBorrow
lenders.parent_or_aka: iBorrow, LP (founder / CEO Brian Good; predecessor Eagle Group, LLC per third-party profile)
lenders.footprint: National (commercial bridge); assisted living deals reported in Southern California
lenders.property_types: Assisted living, SNF, Multifamily, Retail, Industrial, Office, Mixed-use
lenders.programs: Non-recourse bridge loans, Renovation / repositioning bridge, Refinance
lenders.broker_program: No broker program confirmed in search results. Direct private CRE lender; funded by a credit facility of up to $150M from Encina Lender Finance and Sterling National Bank.
lenders.fit_notes: LA-based private bridge lender with a CA assisted living track record: $16.5M on two ALFs (Tarzana / Orange County), $13.5M on a 199-bed Anaheim ALF, $12.5M Oxnard and $9.3M Long Beach ALF renovation loans, $6M Pasadena SNF. Those deals are mostly 2017-2019; a non-healthcare refinance in Aug 2025 shows it is still active. Loan size sources conflict ($1.5M-$30M vs $3M-$100M+).

lenders.name: Marathon Asset Management - Commercial Real Estate (senior housing lending)
lenders.broker_program: No broker portal. Takes intermediary-arranged deals: its $235M senior mortgage on an 11-community, 1,564-unit Discovery Senior Living portfolio (Feb 2026) was arranged by CBRE National Senior Housing.
lenders.contact_title: Led the Marathon CRE team on the Feb 2026 senior housing loan (per press release)
lenders.fit_notes: Private credit manager that closed a $235M senior housing portfolio refinance in 2026 through a mortgage banker (CBRE). Large-balance only; worth having for big stabilized or near-stabilized portfolios. No CA senior deal found.

lenders.name: IRA Capital - Credit platform (senior housing lending)
lenders.parent_or_aka: IRA Capital (real estate private equity firm); co-lent with Artemis Real Estate Partners on its 2026 senior housing loan
lenders.footprint: West Coast / National (2026 loan secured by WA and OR assets)
lenders.programs: First-lien senior housing loans (described as bridge in secondary coverage), Senior housing equity (separate strategy)
lenders.broker_program: No broker program published. Its credit platform closed a $235M loan (June 25, 2026) on two Watermark communities, Bellevue WA (291 units) and Portland OR (243 units), alongside Artemis. A secondary source says IRA has originated about $550M of private debt over two years (unverified).
lenders.fit_notes: California-based (Irvine) sponsor that now lends on senior housing, and a senior housing owner-operator investor in CA since its 2022 $106M CA acquisition. Large-balance West Coast senior housing credit. Broker acceptance and CA loans are not documented.

lenders.name: Wells Fargo - Senior Housing Finance (commercial real estate)
lenders.parent_or_aka: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.; Other desk of Wells Fargo Multifamily Capital (already in directory)
lenders.programs: Balance-sheet acquisition, repositioning, renovation and construction loans; Note-on-note / loan-on-loan financing; Agency take-out via Wells Fargo Multifamily
lenders.term: About 3 yr initial + two 1-yr extensions (older trade report), then permanent take-out
lenders.broker_program: No broker program published. Relationship / agent-bank lender; acted as administrative agent on a $557M note-on-note financing secured by seven senior housing facilities in five states (Mar 2026).
lenders.fit_notes: Other desk of Wells Fargo Multifamily Capital. Dedicated senior housing finance group (formed 2015) focused on private-pay IL / AL / MC balance-sheet loans, with San Diego-area seniors deals. Best for large, well-sponsored operators; small-broker access is unlikely.

lenders.broker_program: No broker program found. Healthcare finance team with dedicated senior living underwriters (job postings for 'Healthcare / Senior Living Facilities' underwriters).
lenders.fit_notes: $72.2B-asset bank with a named healthcare finance / senior living group serving for-profit and not-for-profit operators. Midwest-centric; CA appetite unconfirmed.
